title: Android TV 大曲库与封面加载性能优化
baseline: NAS-Music-TV-播放器稳定性性能优化版.zip
goals: Move embedded cover file reads and ID3/APIC extraction away from Compose main thread
Avoid duplicate APIC extraction for the same local audio file
Cancel stale cover prefetch requests during rapid track changes and AppRoot disposal
Reduce temporary list/set allocations during large-library artist index updates and search merge
Ensure artist index updates replace stale song metadata and remove changed artist associations

design_summary.before: UnifiedSongRow used remember with synchronous EmbeddedCoverExtractor.extractCoverUri; remember does not switch dispatchers.
design_summary.after: A shared produceState helper runs local cover extraction and sidecar file checks in Dispatchers.IO; initial UI uses existing coverUrl as fallback.
design_summary.behavior: Cover priority remains unchanged; embedded artwork may replace the fallback after asynchronous extraction.

design_summary.before: getCoverCandidates was synchronous and could perform file checks/APIC extraction on caller thread.
design_summary.after: getCoverCandidates is suspend and wraps candidate construction in withContext(Dispatchers.IO).
design_summary.behavior: Callers must run in coroutine context; all in-repository call sites were migrated/verified.

design_summary.before: Prefetch requests had no explicit request handle management, no URL cap, and no AppRoot dispose cleanup.
design_summary.after: Normalize and cap to 12 unique URLs, track Coil Disposable handles, cancel prior generations, and expose cancelPending for disposal.
design_summary.behavior: Completed Coil cache entries remain; in-flight obsolete prefetches are disposed.

design_summary.before: Different UI surfaces could concurrently extract the same file; local cache key was based on path only.
design_summary.after: 32 striped per-key locks serialize same-key extraction; local file cache key includes resolved path, lastModified and length.
design_summary.behavior: Changed local files with different mtime/size no longer hit stale positive or negative APIC cache entries; content URI versioning remains URI-only.

design_summary.before: Artist index batches copied all artist lists; updates with same songId could leave stale Song objects; changed artist names could leave old associations.
design_summary.after: Pure Kotlin ArtistSongIndex shallow-copies maps, copies only affected artist lists, updates by songId, and batch-filters removed associations.
design_summary.behavior: Artist grouping reflects latest metadata while untouched lists may be structurally shared.

design_summary.before: For each search result, the UI rebuilt a Set from the complete artist list and allocated another list on append.
design_summary.after: ArtistSongIndex.mergeSearchResults copies a touched list once and creates its ID set once.
design_summary.behavior: Existing artist list entries retain priority; only missing song IDs are appended.

reason: remember memoizes values but does not move disk IO off the Compose main thread
ID3/APIC extraction while scrolling may cause TV UI frame stalls
changes: add rememberEffectiveCoverUrl composable helper
use produceState with Dispatchers.IO for embedded artwork extraction
check downloaded cover sidecar on IO
share helper across row and card layout
retain song.coverUrl as immediate fallback
files.impact: No change to cover priority; extraction completes asynchronously.

reason: cover candidate construction can inspect files and extract embedded artwork
artist index update logic should be independently testable
changes: change getCoverCandidates to suspend
execute candidate checks and APIC extraction in withContext(Dispatchers.IO)
delegate artist map mutation to ArtistSongIndex.append inside existing artistMapsMutex
files.impact: Existing call sites are all coroutine contexts; new callers must also use coroutine context.

reason: synchronous remember candidate generation executes during composition
prefetch tasks should follow queue changes and app root lifecycle
changes: remove synchronous remember around getCoverCandidates
resolve current/previous/next candidates in a LaunchedEffect on IO
add queue index and neighbor song IDs to effect keys
cancel pending cover prefetch on DisposableEffect disposal
files.impact: Current/neighbor prefetch responds to queue changes and cleans up when AppRoot leaves composition.

reason: rapid track changes can leave obsolete image requests consuming network and decode resources
misbehaving backend can return an excessive number of candidate URLs
changes: trim, remove blank and deduplicate URLs
cap each prefetch generation at 12 URLs
track Coil Disposable handles
cancel previous generation immediately when the AppRoot effect starts and again when the new prefetch generation registers
use generation checks to dispose requests enqueued by stale generations
add cancelPending lifecycle method
files.impact: Only in-flight obsolete requests are cancelled; completed Coil cache entries remain.

reason: same song can be requested concurrently by queue, list and player view
path-only cache key cannot detect a file modified in place
changes: add 32 striped per-key extraction locks
run cache lookup, negative cache lookup, header read, APIC parsing and cache write under same-key lock
include file lastModified and length in local file cache key
retain URI-based key for content URI sources
files.impact: Same-key duplicate APIC reads are coalesced; changed local files with changed mtime/length get a fresh cache entry.

reason: old merge rebuilt a Set from an entire artist song list for every search result
changes: replace inline repeated list/set merge with ArtistSongIndex.mergeSearchResults
files.impact: Preserves existing-first dedupe and normalized collaboration grouping with fewer allocations.

reason: artist indexing logic should be isolated from Android ViewModel and Compose for testing
large-library indexing should avoid copying unaffected artist lists
changes: add immutable-input append algorithm with shallow map copies
copy only artist lists touched by the batch
replace stale Song object when same songId is updated
remove old artist associations when the artist field changes
defer list deletion to one filtering pass per artist
add linear-style search result merge with one ID set per artist
files.impact: New immutable maps published to StateFlow; unaffected artist list references are shared.

reason: protect artist index append/update/remove and search merge behavior
changes: add six regression test methods
files.impact: Covers collaboration grouping, input immutability, same-ID update, changed artist, empty bucket cleanup, search dedupe and untouched-list sharing.

changes: add large-library and cover loading optimization summary

reason: preserve technical rationale and boundaries in project overview
changes: append section 10.282

reason: provide a detailed file-by-file implementation and verification record
changes: document goals, context, behavior, files, complexity, validation, limitations and TV-only scope

reason: allow AI and automation to parse changes without relying on prose extraction
changes: record baseline, platform, goals, behavior, per-file actions, verification and limitations
